messages:
Jin: heads up — saw a config rollout (rolloutId=r-942) cause a routing bounce in us-east at ~10:02. p95 latency climbed and we hit quota denies. log excerpt:

Jin: ```
2026-03-21T10:02:13Z route-alloc fail: target_quota_exceeded key=route-weight service=token-service cohort=r-942-1
2026-03-21T10:02:14Z proxy: upstream 502 for route-id=gen-14
```

deploy-bot: automated: applied config r-942 to 10% cohorts (v2.1.3) by @Jin :gear:

Maya: linking dashboards — p95 latency +120ms, errors +0.7% (above our 0.5% soft gate). Looks concentrated on token-service shards 3/7.

Alex: could be cohort hashing drift after the new scope field landed. The runtime was picking different buckets for a small fraction. I pushed a guard to prefer `cohort_id` header if present.

Sam: we should add an operator-bounce-protection in the console: fail any apply if the same config key has >5 state changes in 10m, and surface a daily "rollout health" quick-check in the console. Prevents rapid flip-flop causing route thrash.

Maria: telemetry gating idea: require a quality gate before bumping >25% -> 100%. Gate rule: no metric regression > threshold for 30m rolling samples. Also we need a cohort-divergence metric (how many IDs moved between cohorts after a change).

Jin: +1. Also we should include a short, minimal API to make rollouts observable/operable:

Jin: ```json
{"rollout_id":"r-942","cohort_selector":"stable-hash(header.user_id,\"salt-v1\")","max_flap":5,"telemetry_gates":["p95_latency","error_rate"],"gate_thresholds":{"p95_latency":0.12,"error_rate":0.005}}
```

Alex: nit: ensure each apply stores operator id + monotonic change number and supports `dry_run=true` so console can simulate cohort assignment without flipping production routes. Also add `rollback_hint` field so UI can pre-compute quick rollback.

Sam: I'll add the console banner: "Rolling out r-942 — 10%" and a small realtime panel showing gate metrics + cohort-divergence. Will wire to telemetry stream (sampled at 1/10 for detailed traces).

Maya: ops: we'll roll back to r-941 now and open the incident runbook. tagging SRE. :thumbsup:

Jin: thanks — after rollback I'll follow up with a small middleware: `rollout-safe-check` that rejects applies that exceed flap limits or cohort-shift thresholds. Also schedule a daily job to compute cohort-stability and notify config owners.

Maria: can we also add an alert in the console if cohort-divergence > 0.02 for any rollout? That's a good early warning.

Alex: agreed. I'll draft a tiny API PR for the rollout metadata fields and `dry_run` semantics today.

Sam: ok I'll start the UI PR for the banner + panel.

deploy-bot: action: rollback to r-941 initiated by @Maya at 2026-03-21T10:16:02Z.

Jin: great — let's sync after the rollback on a 30-min postmortem and decide thresholds.
